Definition
[curvature scale] Source: kleiner-lott 1. Definition 1\group Kleiner–Lott Long-Time Topology

For $x \in \M _t^+$, let $\rho (x,t)$ be the unique number $\rho \in (0,\infty )$ such that $\inf _{B^+(x,t, \rho )} \Rm \: = \: - \: \rho ^{-2}$, if such a $\rho $ exists, and put $\rho (x,t)=\infty $ otherwise.

Lemma
[thick--thin geometry lemma]
